outcome: effects of low-dose PGE1 (including dose escalation, edema, hyperthermia, gastrointestinal problems, apnea)
cohort: Term newborns diagnosed with duct-dependent congenital heart disease monitored in a pediatric cardiac intensive care unit.
finding: Low-dose PGE1 usage in term newborns with duct-dependent congenital heart disease was effective in maintaining duct patency and showed a decrease in adverse effects compared to reported rates in the literature.
